review_basis: Each listed original PDF page was rendered and individually displayed for visual inspection; other pages were not visually reviewed.

review_notes.1: Publication identity, license and study scope readable.
review_notes.2: Figure1 seasonal schematic arrows are illustrative. The bold contour follows the thermocline ridge, not a diagnosed current axis. Vector-key units differ from caption.
review_notes.3: Model domain, resolution, simulation period and initial five-year exclusion reviewed. Model domain boundaries are not physical current endpoints.
review_notes.6: Figure4 model SSH0.4m and altimetry ADT0.8m use different reference levels. Neither supplies paired current boundaries.
review_notes.7: Figure5 caption period2009–2020 differs from methods analysis period2010–2020. Preserve both labels.
review_notes.10: Figure8 selected SON CTRL examples are dated seasonal model states, not a monthly climatology. Mooring coordinate labels and Oceanclim year-pattern statements need reconciliation.
review_notes.11: Figure9 sensitivity experiment differs from CTRL; do not combine experiments into annual extrema.
